findings.en_sentence: While a popular story says Mary Ann Mantell found the first teeth in Tilgate Forest in 1822, evidence indicates Gideon Mantell actually discovered them himself.
findings.es_sentence: Si bien una historia popular dice que Mary Ann Mantell encontró los primeros dientes en el Bosque de Tilgate en 1822, la evidencia indica que Gideon Mantell los descubrió en realidad él mismo.
findings.problem: States that evidence shows Gideon found the teeth himself; the source says Mantell gave contradictory accounts (credited Mary Ann in 1827 and 1833, claimed them himself in 1851) and later authors hold the story is not certainly false.
findings.correct: The popular story credits Mary Ann Mantell with finding the first teeth in 1822; Mantell's own accounts contradict each other, so who found them is uncertain.
findings.checked_in: enwiki 'Gideon Mantell, Sir Richard Owen, and the discovery of dinosaurs' (oldid 1383267898); F005

findings.en_sentence: In 2026, Rotatori and colleagues suggested that Delapparentia is a distinct taxon related to Magnamanus and I. galvensis, proposing a new genus name for the latter.
findings.es_sentence: En 2026, Rotatori y colegas sugirieron que *Delapparentia* es un taxón distinto relacionado con *Magnamanus* e *I. galvensis*, proponiendo un nuevo nombre de género para este último.
findings.problem: Rotatori et al. only said that I. galvensis would need a new genus name; they did not propose one. The page also never says that I. galvensis had already been moved to Paulodon in 2025, and it never introduces Delapparentia, Magnamanus or I. galvensis.
findings.correct: In 2026 Rotatori and colleagues argued that Delapparentia is a distinct taxon close to Magnamanus and 'I.' galvensis, and that the latter would need its own genus name.
findings.checked_in: enwiki '21st century research and the splitting of the genus'; F044, F045

findings.en_sentence: Research published in 2026 interprets I. bernissartensis as likely being an obligate quadruped.
findings.es_sentence: Una investigación publicada en 2026 interpreta a *I. bernissartensis* como probablemente un cuadrúpedo obligado.
findings.problem: Calls I. bernissartensis a likely obligate quadruped without noting that this conflicts with the page's own statements that it switched between bipedal and quadrupedal gait and reached 24 km/h on two legs.
findings.correct: Present the 2026 result as a new interpretation that challenges the traditional view of a facultative biped/quadruped, e.g. 'A 2026 study argues that, contrary to the traditional view, I. bernissartensis was probably an obligate quadruped.'
findings.checked_in: F031, F072, F146; enwiki 'Posture and movement'; Gônet, Allain & Houssaye 2026

findings.en_sentence: The lower jaw of this dinosaur featured a toothless, scoop-shaped front that looks similar to the structure found in two-toed sloths and the extinct ground sloth Mylodon.
findings.es_sentence: La mandíbula inferior de este dinosaurio presentaba un frente sin dientes y en forma de pala que se asemeja a la estructura de los perezosos de dos dedos y del perezoso terrestre extinto *Mylodon*.
findings.problem: The sloth/Mylodon comparison was Mantell's 19th-century opinion, but it is given as a present-day anatomical fact. The toothless front is the predentary/beak region.
findings.correct: Mantell compared the toothless, scoop-shaped front of the lower jaw to that of two-toed sloths and the extinct ground sloth Mylodon.
findings.checked_in: enwiki 'Feeding' ('which he found best compared to...'); F063

findings.en_sentence: However, iguanodontians in general are thought to have evolved alongside the rise of flowering plants during the Cretaceous.
findings.es_sentence: Sin embargo, se piensa que los iguanodontianos en general evolucionaron junto con el auge de las plantas con flores durante el Cretácico.
findings.problem: Turns a disputed hypothesis (low-browsing iguanodonts favoured the spread of angiosperms) into an accepted fact ('are thought to have evolved alongside'). The source adds that the evidence is not conclusive.
findings.correct: However, iguanodonts have also been linked, hypothetically, to the spread of flowering plants in the Cretaceous because of their inferred low-browsing habits, although the evidence is not conclusive.

findings.es_sentence: Sin embargo, se piensa que los iguanodontianos en general evolucionaron junto con el auge de las plantas con flores durante el Cretácico.
findings.problem: The Spanish text drops the sentence about David Norman's proposed diet (horsetails, cycads, conifers), so 'Sin embargo' contrasts with nothing. The Spanish has 26 sentences against 27 in English.
findings.correct: Restore before it: 'David Norman propuso una dieta de colas de caballo, cícadas y coníferas.'
findings.checked_in: texts en vs es, section 4; F128

findings.en_sentence: A banquet for twenty guests was once held inside the famous standing sculpture of Iguanodon before the artwork was finished.
findings.es_sentence: Antes de finalizar la obra, se celebró una vez un banquete para veinte comensales dentro de la famosa escultura de pie del *Iguanodon*.
findings.problem: The 'famous standing sculpture' (Hawkins's Crystal Palace model, 1853) is never introduced. It was also based on the Maidstone specimen, which the page itself says was later removed from Iguanodon.
findings.correct: Benjamin Waterhouse Hawkins held a banquet for twenty inside the mould of his standing Crystal Palace 'Iguanodon' (based on the Maidstone specimen) before the sculpture was finished.
findings.checked_in: enwiki 'Gideon Mantell...' and 'In popular culture' (Crystal Palace models of Mantellodon); F023, F011

findings.en_sentence: Iguanodon lived during the late Early Cretaceous, between 126 and 120 million years ago, in what is now Europe.
findings.es_sentence: *Iguanodon* vivió en el Cretácico Inferior tardío, entre 126 y 120 millones de años atrás, en lo que ahora es Europa.
findings.problem: The 126–120 Ma range comes from eswiki. Enwiki (taxobox and lead) gives about 126–122 Ma (Barremian to early Aptian) for I. bernissartensis.
findings.correct: ...between about 126 and 122 million years ago (Barremian to early Aptian)...
findings.checked_in: enwiki lead and taxobox; eswiki intro; F090

findings.en_sentence: When walking on two legs, the animal could reach a top speed of 24 km/h, but it was unable to gallop while on four legs.
findings.es_sentence: Al caminar sobre dos patas, el animal podía alcanzar una velocidad máxima de 24 km/h, pero no era capaz de galopar sobre cuatro patas.
findings.problem: The 24 km/h figure is an estimate, but it is given as a measured fact. 'Walking' also does not fit a top speed.
findings.correct: Its top speed has been estimated at about 24 km/h, moving on two legs; it could not have galloped on all fours.

findings.en_sentence: This genus is one of the three original groups used to define the entire Dinosauria clade, alongside Megalosaurus and Hylaeosaurus.
findings.es_sentence: Este género es uno de los tres grupos originales utilizados para definir todo el clado Dinosauria, junto con *Megalosaurus* y *Hylaeosaurus*.
findings.problem: Owen (1842) based Dinosauria on three genera, not 'groups', and he erected it as a Linnaean rank, not a clade.
findings.correct: This is one of the three genera on which Owen originally based the name Dinosauria, alongside Megalosaurus and Hylaeosaurus.

findings.en_sentence: Fossils from Nehden show a wide range of ages, suggesting I. bernissartensis may have lived in groups.
findings.es_sentence: Los fósiles de Nehden muestran una amplia gama de edades, lo que sugiere que *I. bernissartensis* pudo haber vivido en grupos.
findings.problem: Nehden (Germany) is never introduced. Most of its individuals are Mantellisaurus rather than I. bernissartensis, and the source frames this as possible herding of animals migrating through rivers.
findings.correct: At Nehden, Germany, a mixed site with individuals of many ages, some of them I. bernissartensis, may record herding animals.
findings.checked_in: enwiki 'Bernissart mine...' and 'Possible social behaviour'; F020, F080, F136

findings.es_sentence: El nombre del género se estableció en 1825 por el geólogo inglés Gideon Mantell tras examinar fósiles descubiertos en Inglaterra.
findings.problem: Uses a reflexive passive with an agent ('se estableció ... por el geólogo'), which Spanish style guides advise against.
findings.correct: El geólogo inglés Gideon Mantell estableció el nombre del género en 1825 tras examinar fósiles descubiertos en Inglaterra.

findings.es_sentence: Si bien una historia popular dice que Mary Ann Mantell encontró los primeros dientes en el Bosque de Tilgate en 1822, la evidencia indica que Gideon Mantell los descubrió en realidad él mismo.
findings.problem: Translates the place name Tilgate Forest as 'Bosque de Tilgate' and calques 'evidence' as 'la evidencia indica'.
findings.correct: ...en Tilgate Forest en 1822, los indicios apuntan a que fue el propio Gideon Mantell quien los descubrió.

findings.es_sentence: Hacia 1849, Mantell se dio cuenta de que el animal tenía extremidades delanteras delgadas en lugar de la construcción pesada y similar a la de un elefante que se había asumido previamente.
findings.problem: 'construcción pesada' calques English 'build'; the Spanish word for body build is 'complexión'.
findings.correct: ...extremidades delanteras delgadas y no la complexión pesada, de paquidermo, que se había supuesto.

findings.es_sentence: El *Iguanodon* era un gran herbívoro robusto que podía alcanzar longitudes de 9 a 11 metros y pesar hasta 4,5 toneladas métricas.
findings.problem: 'toneladas métricas' calques 'metric tons'; in Spanish, 'toneladas' already means metric tons.

findings.es_sentence: La mandíbula inferior de este dinosaurio presentaba un frente sin dientes y en forma de pala que se asemeja a la estructura de los perezosos de dos dedos y del perezoso terrestre extinto *Mylodon*.
findings.problem: 'un frente sin dientes' calques English 'front'; 'el frente' is not used in Spanish for the front of a jaw.
findings.correct: ...presentaba un extremo anterior sin dientes y en forma de pala...

findings.es_sentence: Antes de finalizar la obra, se celebró una vez un banquete para veinte comensales dentro de la famosa escultura de pie del *Iguanodon*.
findings.problem: 'se celebró una vez' calques 'was once held', and 'escultura de pie del Iguanodon' is clumsy.
findings.correct: Antes de terminar la escultura del Iguanodon erguido, se celebró en su interior un banquete para veinte comensales.

findings.es_sentence: Un ejemplar fósil muestra evidencia de un hueso de cadera fracturado y una lesión en el isquion.
findings.correct: Un ejemplar fósil presenta una fractura de cadera, con una lesión en el isquion.
